note: Naturally labelled posets of width <= 3. Every unlabelled poset appears after relabelling by a linear extension. Counts from compute/census.c (gcc -O3), replayed through n=9 and independently checked at n<=8 by compute/width3_census.py.
published_source: Trotter-Gehrlein-Fishburn 1992 (n<=9 width-3 no smaller than 14/39); Olson-Sagan 2018 (all posets n<=9, width>2 no smaller than 14/39); Saks 1985 (M7 = 14/39).

census.note: minimum achieved by M7 plus a 1-chain (linear sum)
unique unlabelled width-3 poset beating 14/39: n_below equals e(W10). Independently checked in verify_W10.py.
